generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native-scale Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait neutral eye animation atlas
Primary request: Create a clean 2x2 sheet of the same eye/brow region shown in the reference, with row-major poses: open, half-lidded, fully closed, repeated open. The reference is a repeated grid of NPC 078's original upper face; use it for identity, crop, palette, line weight, and geometry.
Style/medium: Preserve the reference's soft, muted 64x64-era painted-pixel portrait style, warm skin palette, gentle low-resolution edges, and brown hair.
Composition/framing: Exactly four equal cells in a seamless 2 columns by 2 rows atlas, matching the reference cell framing. No labels, gutters, borders, added margins, text, or background changes.
Constraints: Keep both eyebrows neutral and identical in height, shape, color, and position in all four cells. Keep eye spacing, eye shape, iris/pupil width, color, and horizontal position stable. Only animate eyelid coverage: first cell naturally open; second subtly half-lidded; third naturally fully closed; fourth exactly repeat the first open pose. In each pose both eyes move together. Keep the same face identity and restrained native palette. No blinking flash, no eye widening, no eyebrow lift, no gaze change, no face redesign, no extra details, no smoothing, no blur.

qualityLimits: Generated atlas is 1695x928 RGB; width is odd, so it is not exactly divisible into two equal pixel cells. Do not infer native cell bounds from nominal layout.
Visible row seam and texture/feature drift may occur; repeated open cell is not guaranteed pixel-identical to first open.
Generated eyebrows, iris geometry, eyelid coverage, and source pixels are not proven stable at native scale; parent must inspect before selection.
No native 64x35 eye-half slicing, opaque mask compositing, or original-outside-mask check was performed.
